revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the commercial owner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. Dispatch now watches total fleet size as well as Type B recovery. If Type A plus Type B trucks exceed 115 in total, the carrier opens a regional recovery desk costing 100; the existing Type B threshold still applies separately. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
